name: @hyunlord/lattice
description: Source-backed maps of repository components, dependencies and call paths

scripts.build: tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.cli.json && tsc -p tsconfig.viewer.json && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json && node tools/build-viewer.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.cli.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.viewer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm test && node tools/check-docs.mjs && node tools/check-benchmarks.mjs
